learning_outcomes.text: The student will be able to handle the chosen programming language for solving engineering problems.
Students will understand the software fundamentals, techniques, notation, and coding principles.

syllabus_topics: Fundamental principles of programming for solving engineering problems
Computational thinking and translation of real-life engineering problems to computation problems
Basic techniques for systematic software design
Basic programming concepts such as program flow control (operators, conditions, loops)
Modular programming (user-defined functions, library functions, file input output operations, memory management, and elementary data structures)
